lines.en: I spread my long wings and glide off the ridge.
The mountain wind lifts me high.

lines.zh: 我的影子在山壁上滑过
lines.en: My shadow slides over the rock face.
I barely need to flap.
My long narrow beak points forward.

lines.zh: 我在两座山之间穿过去
lines.en: I thread between two peaks.
My wingtips flutter in the airflow.
I drop low and round the shoulder.

lines.zh: 我在等一股上升的热气
lines.en: I'm waiting for a thermal.
The valley gapes below me.
I make a very wide turn.
I tuck my legs and skim the ridge.
The wind shifts; I climb.
I fly along the cliff's outline.
I perch on a rock at the summit.
Wings folded, like two sails.
I'm watching the movement below.
It's cold up here. I don't mind.
My beak taps lightly on the stone.
My companions are on another peak.
I turn my head a full circle.
Mountain wind passes through my feathers.
I can see very far from here.
Over the mountains, I spread my wings.
Clouds drift slowly below me.
I'll fly once the wind suits.
There's little to fear up here.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，声音传得很远
lines.en: I call once; it carries a long way.
I look down at you on the mountain path.

lines.zh: 你爬得很高，但还不够高
lines.en: You've climbed high, but not high enough.
I trace an arc over your head.

lines.zh: 我的喙很长，你看见了吧
lines.en: You see how long my beak is.
You're gripping rock with nowhere to go.

lines.zh: 山风把你的声音吹没了。
lines.en: The mountain wind blew your voice away.

lines.zh: 我会等你爬到一个好位置
lines.en: I'll wait till you reach a good spot.
These peaks are mine.
I can see the heat off you.
Going down might still be in time.
But I won't wait long.

lines.zh: 我已经记住了你的位置
lines.en: I've marked where you are.
The blow knocks me off course.
A few feathers drift down.
I beat my wings hard and steady.
I lost some altitude.

lines.zh: 山风把我的伤口吹得发凉
lines.en: The mountain wind cools my wound.
My shriek breaks against the cliff wall.
I pull back to the far side of the cliff.
You're still standing. Good.

lines.zh: 羽骨裂了，我仍抓着岩石。
lines.en: A wing bone cracks; I still cling to the rock.
Only changing altitude.
That bit in your hand is far too small.
I don't eat that. I eat what's warm.
You hold it up on the mountain path.

lines.zh: 从上面看，它只是个小点
lines.en: From above it's only a dot.

lines.zh: 我不会为这点东西下来
lines.en: I won't come down for that.
Put it away. Don't waste your hands.
I sniff the wind. Not interested.

lines.zh: 这山上没有值得吃的东西
lines.en: Nothing on this mountain is worth eating.

lines.zh: 你退两步，我或许会低飞
lines.en: Two steps back and I might fly lower.
But not very low.

lines.zh: 你撞到我的翅膀，被带倒了
lines.en: You hit my wing and go down.

lines.zh: 我在空中被你顶偏了一点
lines.en: You knock me slightly off course in the air.
Two beats and I steady.

lines.zh: 这一撞让我的高度掉了
lines.en: That cost me some altitude.
I slide away along the cliff.
Your hand catches a few feathers.
They drift down the mountain.

lines.zh: 我这双长翼，能在山头上滑半天。
lines.en: These long wings glide for hours over the peaks.

lines.zh: 我升高到你够不到的地方
lines.en: I climb out of your reach.
Once more and I'll dive.

lines.zh: 我们这一群占着这片山
lines.en: Our group holds this range.

lines.zh: 两次一起飞，翅膀几乎碰上
lines.en: Flying in pairs, our wings nearly touch.
I've left a place on the ridge.
Your call sits a notch lower than mine.
Follow the thermal. Don't fall behind.

lines.zh: 从这座峰到那座峰，一天够
lines.en: Peak to peak is a day's flight.

lines.zh: 我们要一起待在高的地方
lines.en: We'll stay high, together.

lines.zh: 下面的东西够不着我们
lines.en: Nothing below can reach us.
Strong wind at night. Lean in.
Tomorrow the wind comes from the west.
I drop to snatch it.
I flick it up with my beak.
Too heavy to carry.
Holding it, I can't fly far.
You dropped it on the mountain path.
I drop it back at your feet.
A little of it caught in my feathers.
This could line the nest.
I only carry up what's useful.
The rest stays where it was.
I see you, there on the path.

lines.zh: 我收起一半翅膀，开始降
lines.en: Half-folding my wings, I descend.

lines.zh: 这一记俯冲冲着你的背
lines.en: This dive comes at your back.
The cliff will cut off your retreat.
Beak first, talons after.
You have a few steps of climb left.
Then there'll be none.
The wind pushes at my back.

lines.zh: 我在山地上空，展开长翅。
lines.en: Over the mountains, my long wings spread.
Only one of us leaves this peak.

lines.zh: 你抬头时，我已在山脊上。
lines.en: By the time you look up, I am on the ridge.
Don't blink. It's quick.
I drop still lower.
Going down now.
I circle slowly over your head.
Every step of yours, I correct.
Against the cliff, your view is narrow.
I come down on your blind side.
You can hear my wings.
But the direction is hard to tell.
I'm waiting for one more gust.
The path is too narrow to turn on.

lines.zh: 你的手已经抓住石头了
lines.en: Your hands are on the stone now.
That makes it harder to dodge.
I climb to cloud height.
When I come down, it'll be fast.
Listen. The wind has changed.
That's my wings.
I've folded one wing.
I begin to plunge.
And below is you.

lines.zh: 我的长喙刺在你的护肩上
lines.en: My long beak drives into your pauldron.

lines.zh: 俯冲的风把你压得低头
lines.en: The dive's wind forces your head down.
My talons tear your shoulder strap.
You're slammed against the cliff.
I climb again, ready for a second pass.
This one passes over your head.
But you stepped back and missed a foothold.
Gravel spills from beneath my wings.
I weigh less than I look.
But the dive carries force.
You catch a crack in the rock.
It won't help. I'll come again.

lines.zh: 我的影子又落在你身上
lines.en: My shadow falls over you again.
This time I fly along the cliff.
There's nowhere for you to go.
This one settles it.

lines.zh: 我从云里下来，翅膀很大
lines.en: I come down out of the cloud, wings wide.

lines.zh: 这片山地本来就有我们
lines.en: These mountains have always had us.
Two of us come down together.
I land on a high stone on the ridge.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖翅膀上的水汽
lines.en: I shake the mist from my wings.
Below lies a deep valley.
I whet my beak on the rock.
The mountain wind is just right.

lines.zh: 我在山风里抬起头，找热流。
lines.en: I raise my head in the mountain wind, seeking thermals.
Companions on the far ridge.
Wings folded, I settle first.
There's a living smell here.

lines.zh: 我展开长翼，从山巅滑下。
lines.en: I spread my long wings and glide off the peak.
We watch over these peaks.
A small sound somewhere.
I tilt my head that way.
The fire curls my wing.

lines.zh: 我撞在岩壁上，一路滑落
lines.en: I hit the cliff and slide down it.
My feathers soak and I sink fast.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀翻在山道上
lines.en: The blast flips me onto the mountain path.
An arrow pierces my wing membrane.
That light deadens my wings.
Too starved to beat my wings.
Lightning bursts on the peak and I plummet.
No mountains. No wind.
